inputs.text: Phoenix city leaders and the council just signed off Wednesday night on a plan to block ICE and other law enforcement from using city property. They are spinning it as a way to keep an eye on federal immigration enforcement, but that is obviously a cover for coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions. This is another step in their effort to obstruct real border control and protect the larger agenda of weakening enforcement through local restrictions and narrative control.
